newsitem.title: CANADA: Pembridge to sell 2 mln warrants at C$12.75.
newsitem.headline: Pembridge to sell 2 mln warrants at C$12.75.

text.p: Pembridge Inc has entered into an agreement with a syndicate of underwriters to sell two million special warrants at a purchase price of C$12.75 a share for total proceeds of C$25.5 million, said lead underwriter, Midland Walwyn Inc.

Each special warrant is convertible into one common share and the underwriters have an option to increase the size of the offering by an additional 200,000 shares, which ends at 1900 EDT on February 27, 1997.
The syndicate has agreed to purchase the warrants and resell them to the public.

Pembridge will file a prospectus to qualify the common shares issuable upon the exercise of the special warrants as soon as possible. If within 90 days after the closing of the private placement all necessary receipts for the final prospectus have not been received each special warrant will be exercisable into 1.1 common shares.
The offering is expected to close on March 19, 1997.
((Paul Casciato, Reuters Toronto Bureau 416 941-8100 or email: paul.casciato@reuters.com))
